correctness.rationale: For genuine continuous copulas in the source scheme, the upper endpoint requires lim phi(v)=1. The source interior conditions imply 0<=phi<=1 because (v phi) is monotone from zero. Integrating v phi prime <=1 up to b<1 and sending b to 1 proves phi(v)>=1+log v; this would not be valid without upper-boundary continuity. This yields exact envelope max(0,1+log v), hence the integral upper bound I<=(1-exp(-2))/4. The equality function is continuous but nondifferentiable at exp(-1), proving strict nonattainment. An explicit smooth admissible CDF phi_epsilon satisfies v phi_prime=t/(1+t) in (0,1) and converges pointwise to the envelope; dominated convergence proves optimality. The integral identities rho=-2I and tau=-4I/3 follow by exact copula/density integration with D(0)=D(1)=0 and bounded D prime. Continuity and epsilon-to-infinity limit give the entire interior range, and phi=1 gives independence. The packaged checker symbolically verifies Kendall inner integration and the sharp envelope integral, and numerically checks smooth convergence.

originality.rationale: The source establishes the copula, twelve examples and concordance for four studied families, not an optimal full-class rank-correlation capacity. Older quadratic-section work explicitly covers the 2/3 ratio and general validity, so no novelty is claimed for those ingredients. The specific differentiable-source derivative constraint creates a sharp logarithmic obstacle with a new exact -0.432332... negative rank-correlation infimum and an explicit smooth near-extremal family. Directly inspected primary texts and targeted database/source searches did not reveal the sharp source-specific theorem. The final scope explicitly enforces the endpoint continuity necessary for a genuine copula, rather than relying uncritically on the source proposition.
residual_risks: An unindexed recent note or unpublished work may independently derive the exact same variational endpoint.

The source proposition omits an explicit upper-endpoint continuity hypothesis; discontinuous formal functions that satisfy its interior inequalities need not produce copulas, and are excluded by the final theorem.
The earlier conference abstract is dated by its meeting interval, 20–22 February 2025, not by an independently verified online-upload time or individual presentation day.

value.rationale: The primary paper presents a flexible full function-based asymmetric copula class but quantifies only four subfamilies, leaving the strongest achievable negative dependence unknown. The theorem gives the complete attainable rho/tau dependence capacity and a smooth one-parameter admissible family reaching strictly stronger negative dependence than all four extensively studied examples. It also supplies a rigorous diagnostic limitation: population rank-correlation pairs outside the line segment are impossible for the whole source scheme, no matter how its tuning function is chosen. This is a natural sharp optimization of a central dependence property, not merely a restatement of the known rho/tau ratio. The diagnostic applies to actual continuous copulas; formal endpoint-discontinuous expressions are not probability models.
